segments.speaker: Deepa
segments.text: Aman, workload kaisa chal raha hai is sprint mein?

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Thoda zyada hai. Analytics side project aur payments dono saath mein handle karna mushkil ho raha hai.

segments.speaker: Deepa
segments.text: Toh analytics wala side project abhi ke liye chhod do, payments pe focus karo.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Theek hai, main analytics project drop kar deta hoon.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Promotion ke timeline ke baare mein kuch update hai?

segments.speaker: Deepa
segments.text: Main HR se baat karke is hafte tak timeline confirm kar dungi.

segments.speaker: Deepa
segments.text: Tum apne payments project ka ek summary document likh lo, month end tak.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Done, month end tak document ready hoga.
